biotools.summary: AlertGS is a software resource for determining alerts for gene sets by modeling concentration/time-response relationships and applying a Kolmogorov-Smirnoff type test statistic.  The code is available on GitHub and used to reproduce simulations described in a peer-reviewed publication.
